description: This Java source file defines the ClientRepositoryWrapper class, which provides a wrapper around the ClientRepository for added null checking and error handling when working with Client entities. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and validating client objects within the system.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps calls to ClientRepository, providing additional null checks, error handling, and access control related to Client entities.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Client by ID, throwing an exception if not found. Overloaded to optionally load lazy collections.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of Clients given their IDs.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Persists the Client entity and immediately flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all pending changes to the repository.

methods.name: getActiveClientInUserScope
methods.description: Retrieves an active Client within the user's access scope, throwing exceptions if the client is inactive or not found.

methods.name: getClientByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches a Client based on their account number, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getClientByClientIdAndHierarchy
methods.description: Fetches a Client based on ID and hierarchy string, or throws if not found.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a Client ID based on an ExternalId object.
